agent-manifest.description: Deterministic keeper of the three questions (name, quest, favourite colour) and their correct answers for each knight. Judges a submitted set of answers as all-correct or not. Makes no decision about crossing — it only judges the answers.

offer.body: The three questions, and a judgement of a knight's submitted answers against their registry record (name, quest, favourite colour) — all three must match. The judge is authoritative; the seeker's confidence is not.
Answer correctness is decided by these canonical answers in code, not by the seeker asserting it — a wavering or wrong answer is judged wrong.

use.body: Reads the verified knight's true name, professed quest, and recorded favourite colour to judge the answers.
